article.story: NEW YORK -- — Jordan Jones' 17 points helped Central Connecticut State defeat LIU 63-50 on Thursday night. Jones added five rebounds and three steals for the Blue Devils (15-6, 6-2 Northeast Conference). Jayden Brown scored 12 points, finishing 6 of 10 from the floor. Davonte Sweatman went 4 of 8 from the field to finish with 11 points. The Sharks (10-14, 6-3) were led by Terell Strickland, who recorded 19 points and three steals. Both teams next play Saturday. Central Connecticut State visits Stonehill and LIU plays Chicago State on the road. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
